Slip “Don't Tread On Me” cut unchanged from page 12 of the Players Committee's Virtual Card Master Set, Set 0 sheet ([http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Set-0.pdf]; preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160806222234/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Internet Archive, 6 August 2016]). Version [[Don't Tread On Me (V)]] (Original): the concept credit reads “Original concept by Steven Lewis”, without the later “PC Volunteer Award 2008”. Not a recreation.
